name: Leaf-yeast wine
summary: The cup VOV puts with then singing on the stilt-house floor. VietnamPlus names rượu nếp on the offering trays. The rural desk names rượu suối nguồn Nà Hai as a gift. VnExpress names rượu ngô with the sour shrimp. None of them says these are one spirit.
origin: Pac Ngoi, in the evening. VOV, on Vietnam Tourism's rural desk.
howToEat: A small cup with the meal or with the singing. Not a bar pour. Whether this cup is the glutinous wine, the corn wine, or the Na Hai gift is Check on arrival.
A strength and a price are Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Pac Ngoi, on the house floor. Bo Lu, at Long Tong, is where VietnamPlus puts rượu nếp, which may or may not be this cup.
seoDescription: Rượu men lá, the cup with then singing at Pac Ngoi. Whether it is the same spirit as the festival wine is Check on arrival.
